products.name: Specialty Personal Automobile Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for individuals who have difficulty obtaining standard or preferred risk automobile insurance, typically due to driving records, claims experience, or payment history. Delivered through independent agents, brokers, direct-to-consumer, and captive channels, requiring regulated underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Commercial Automobile Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for businesses, focusing on contractors, short-haul delivery, and sales/services, protecting against vehicle-related risks. Distributed primarily through independent agents and brokers, with regulated underwriting and claims processes.

products.name: Fire/Contents Protection Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for personal property against loss from fire, lightning, and other causes, as well as personal general liability. Sold primarily through career agents, requiring regulated underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Individual Life Insurance
products.description: Individual life insurance products, including permanent, term, and guaranteed issue insurance, offered primarily on a non-participating, guaranteed-cost basis with lower face amounts. Delivered through a network of career agents, involving regulated underwriting and policy servicing.

products.name: Supplemental Accident and Health Insurance
products.description: Supplemental insurance products providing additional accident and health coverage to individuals and families, distributed through career agents and requiring regulated underwriting and claims processing.

products.name: SteraMist Disinfection and Decontamination Equipment
products.description: A line of mobile and permanently installed devices that use patented Binary Ionization Technology (BIT) to generate ionized hydrogen peroxide (iHP) mist for rapid, automated disinfection of indoor air and surfaces. Products include handheld units, backpack systems, room foggers, vehicle foggers, and custom-engineered systems, all manufactured externally and sold globally.

products.name: BIT Solution Consumables
products.description: Proprietary, EPA-registered hydrogen peroxide-based solution (7.8% or 0.35%) used as the consumable for SteraMist equipment, sold on a recurring basis to customers for use in disinfection and decontamination processes. Blended by an EPA-approved third party and shipped globally.

products.name: Decontamination and Disinfection Services
products.description: On-site decontamination and disinfection services for facilities, vehicles, and equipment, delivered by TOMI or certified service providers using SteraMist technology. Services include routine, emergency, and specialized decontamination for life sciences, healthcare, food safety, and commercial clients.

products.name: Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) Services
products.description: Professional services for the installation, validation, and regulatory qualification of SteraMist systems in customer facilities, particularly for life sciences and pharmaceutical clients. Includes documentation and testing to meet GMP, cGMP, and GLP standards.

products.name: OEM Integration of iHP Technology
products.description: Integration of SteraMist iHP technology into third-party enclosures, cleanroom equipment, and material passthroughs via OEM partnerships. Includes custom engineering and co-branded solutions for pharmaceutical, laboratory, and manufacturing applications.

products.name: Commercial Multi-Peril Property Insurance for Residential Condominium Associations
products.description: Provides insurance coverage for residential condominium associations in Florida, covering loss or damage to buildings, inventory, or equipment from causes such as fire, wind, hail, water, theft, and vandalism. Delivered through underwriting, policy issuance, and claims management, primarily via a managing general agency and independent agency network.

products.name: Commercial Multi-Peril Property Insurance for Apartments and Assisted Living Facilities
products.description: Offers insurance coverage for apartment buildings and assisted living facilities in Florida, protecting against loss or damage to property and equipment from covered perils. Delivered through underwriting, policy issuance, and claims management, distributed via wholesaler partners and a managing general agency.

products.name: Commission-Based Equipment Breakdown, Identity Theft, and Flood Insurance Policies
products.description: Acts as a distributor for equipment breakdown, identity theft, and flood insurance policies, earning commissions while ceding all risk to other private insurance companies. These are delivered through agency agreements and do not involve underwriting risk retention by the company.

products.name: Strategy Consulting Services
products.description: Provides strategic advisory services to clients, including business and operating model design, mergers and acquisitions, technology strategies, and sustainability, delivered by industry experts using advanced analytics and design methodologies.

products.name: Management and Technology Consulting Services
products.description: Delivers management and technology consulting to transform organizations, including functional and technology consulting in areas such as finance, supply chain, talent, and digital transformation, leveraging advanced analytics and design expertise.

products.name: Digital Services
products.description: Offers digital transformation services, including customer experience design, digital marketing, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and digital content production, delivered through specialized units such as Accenture Interactive and Applied Intelligence.

products.name: Technology Services and Solutions
products.description: Provides technology services including systems integration, application development and outsourcing, cloud and infrastructure services, security services, and implementation of emerging technologies such as AI, blockchain, and IoT, across leading technology platforms.

products.name: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services
products.description: Operates and manages business processes for clients in functions such as finance, procurement, supply chain, marketing, sales, and industry-specific operations, using a combination of talent, data, AI, and digital technologies.

products.name: Investment Banking Services
products.description: Advisory and underwriting services for corporations, governments, and institutions, including mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and capital raising through equity and debt offerings. Delivered through teams of financial professionals and supported by regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Market Making and Trading Services
products.description: Making markets and facilitating client transactions in fixed income, currency, commodity, and equity products, including both cash and derivative instruments. Delivered via global trading desks, technology platforms, and regulated exchanges, requiring significant capital and risk management.

products.name: Securities Financing and Prime Brokerage
products.description: Providing financing solutions for client trading activities, including margin loans, securities lending, and portfolio financing. Services are delivered through secured lending, collateral management, and technology platforms, requiring regulatory compliance and capital.

products.name: Transaction Banking Services
products.description: Deposit-taking, payments solutions, and cash management services for corporate and institutional clients. Delivered through regulated banking infrastructure and digital platforms, requiring compliance with banking regulations.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Managing client assets across a broad range of investment strategies and asset classes, including equity, fixed income, and alternative investments, through mutual funds, ETFs, private partnerships, and separately managed accounts. Delivered by portfolio managers and supported by regulated investment platforms.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Banking
products.description: Personalized wealth advisory, financial planning, and private banking services for individuals, families, and institutions, including deposit alternatives and secured lending. Delivered through dedicated advisors and digital platforms, requiring regulatory oversight and fiduciary standards.

products.name: Private Lending and Deposit Services
products.description: Issuing loans and raising deposits for wealth management clients and consumers, including through Marcus by Goldman Sachs. Delivered via regulated banking subsidiaries and digital platforms, requiring compliance with consumer and banking regulations.

products.name: Credit Card Issuing (Apple Card)
products.description: Issuing co-branded credit cards and raising deposits from card customers, primarily through digital channels and in partnership with consumer brands. Delivered via regulated banking infrastructure and technology platforms.

products.name: Alternative Investments and Principal Investing
products.description: Investing in public and private equity, credit, real estate, and infrastructure assets, both alongside clients and through managed funds. Delivered via direct investments and consolidated investment entities, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Cell-in-a-Box® Live Cell Encapsulation Platform for Cancer Therapy
products.description: A proprietary cellulose-based encapsulation technology used to encapsulate genetically engineered live human cells, designed to deliver targeted cellular therapies for cancer. The product is physically manufactured using bioinert cellulose capsules and requires specialized manufacturing, regulatory approval, and cold-chain logistics.

products.name: CypCaps™ (Encapsulated Cell Therapy for Pancreatic Cancer)
products.description: A product candidate consisting of genetically engineered live human cells encapsulated in cellulose-based capsules, designed to be implanted near pancreatic tumors to locally activate chemotherapy prodrugs. Requires physical manufacturing, genetic engineering, and regulated clinical delivery.

products.name: Prodrug/Activator Technology for Targeted Chemotherapy
products.description: A therapeutic approach using encapsulated, genetically engineered cells to locally convert administered chemotherapy prodrugs into active cancer-killing agents at tumor sites. Delivered via implantation of encapsulated cells, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical procedures.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of older model, basic and affordable used vehicles (primarily sport utility vehicles, trucks, and sedans) through a network of physical dealerships, with inventory sourced from wholesalers, auctions, rental/fleet companies, and the public. Vehicles are inspected and reconditioned as needed before sale.

products.name: Automotive Financing
products.description: Provision of in-house financing for substantially all customers purchasing vehicles, including origination, servicing, and collection of retail installment contracts, with flexible payment terms and underwriting tailored to customers with limited or challenged credit histories.

products.name: Vehicle Service Contracts
products.description: Sale of optional service contracts covering certain vehicle components and assemblies, with repairs coordinated through third-party service centers. Most customers elect to purchase these contracts at the time of vehicle sale.

products.name: Accident Protection Plan (APP)
products.description: Sale of an accident protection plan to financed customers, contractually obligating the company to cancel the outstanding loan balance if the vehicle is declared a total loss or stolen, available in most operating states.

products.name: Cabozantinib Franchise (CABOMETYX and COMETRIQ)
products.description: Orally administered small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) drugs, manufactured as tablets (CABOMETYX) and capsules (COMETRIQ), for the treatment of various cancers including renal cell carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, differentiated thyroid cancer, pancreatic and extra-pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and medullary thyroid cancer. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally, with commercialization supported by internal and partner sales teams.

products.name: Zanzalintinib Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule kinase inhibitor for cancer treatment, currently in late-stage clinical development and under regulatory review for colorectal cancer and other solid tumors. Delivered as a manufactured oral drug, with ongoing pivotal trials for multiple cancer indications.

products.name: COTELLIC (Cobimetinib)
products.description: Oral small molecule MEK inhibitor for the treatment of advanced melanoma, marketed as part of combination regimens through a collaboration with Genentech. Manufactured and distributed as a pharmaceutical product.

products.name: MINNEBRO (Esaxerenone)
products.description: Oral, non-steroidal, selective mineralocorticoid receptor blocker for the treatment of hypertension, approved and marketed in Japan through a license to Daiichi Sankyo. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical product.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) and Biotherapeutics Pipeline
products.description: Early-stage pipeline of biotherapeutic oncology candidates, including antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and bispecific antibodies, developed through internal research and collaborations. These are biologically engineered drugs manufactured using advanced antibody and conjugation technologies, currently in preclinical and phase 1 trials for various cancers.

products.name: SYFOVRE (pegcetacoplan injection)
products.description: A biologic drug administered by intravitreal injection for the treatment of geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration (GA). Manufactured via chemical synthesis and purification, then formulated for injection and distributed through specialty distributors and pharmacies. Delivered by retina specialists and ophthalmologists in clinical settings.

products.name: EMPAVELI (pegcetacoplan)
products.description: A biologic drug administered by subcutaneous injection for the treatment of rare diseases including paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH), C3 glomerulopathy (C3G), and primary immune complex membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (IC-MPGN). Manufactured via chemical synthesis and purification, then formulated for injection and distributed through a specialty pharmacy model to healthcare professionals and treatment centers.

products.name: Aspaveli (pegcetacoplan, ex-U.S. systemic)
products.description: A biologic drug (systemic pegcetacoplan) for rare diseases (including C3G and primary IC-MPGN), commercialized outside the U.S. by Swedish Orphan Biovitrum AB (Sobi) under license. Manufactured and supplied for ex-U.S. markets, with Apellis receiving royalties and milestone payments.

products.name: SYFOVRE plus APL-3007 Combination Therapy (in development)
products.description: A next-generation combination therapy for geographic atrophy, combining intravitreal SYFOVRE with APL-3007, a small interfering RNA (siRNA) designed to comprehensively block complement activity in the retina and choroid. Delivered via injection, currently in Phase 2 clinical trials.

products.name: Gene Editing Therapeutics (in development, e.g., APL-9099)
products.description: Preclinical gene editing therapies targeting complement system components, such as APL-9099 (targeting the neonatal Fc receptor, FcRn), developed in collaboration with Beam Therapeutics. These are intended as one-time dosing treatments for complement-driven diseases, leveraging proprietary base editing technology.

products.name: Data Collaboration Platform
products.description: A cloud-based enterprise platform that enables organizations to unify, connect, and collaborate on customer and prospect data across internal and external systems, supporting identity resolution, data onboarding, connectivity, and analytics. Delivered as a subscription SaaS product, it integrates with over 500 partners and is built for privacy, security, and interoperability.

products.name: Identity Resolution Services
products.description: Enterprise identity infrastructure and technology that resolves disparate consumer identities across channels and devices, creating a unified, privacy-centric customer view for audience segmentation, targeting, and measurement. Delivered digitally via proprietary graphs and connectors such as RampID.

products.name: Data Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace platform that connects data sellers and buyers, enabling the monetization, discovery, and distribution of third-party audience data segments across the marketing ecosystem. Revenue is generated through revenue-sharing and transactional arrangements.

products.name: Data Onboarding and Connectivity Services
products.description: Technology and services that ingest customer first-party data, pseudonymize it, and connect it to digital and TV ecosystems through integrations with marketing platforms, publishers, and personalization tools. Delivered digitally and at scale via direct integrations.

products.name: Data Analytics and Measurement Services
products.description: Advanced analytics and measurement solutions, including clean room technology, that enable customers to securely combine and analyze disparate data sets for insight-driven innovation, campaign measurement, sales lift analysis, and cross-channel attribution. Delivered digitally via the platform and partner integrations.

products.name: Professional Services and Support
products.description: Consulting, implementation, data science analytics, audience measurement, and advisory services to help customers leverage the platform and drive business outcomes. Delivered by in-person and remote human labor, typically as project-based or bundled services.

products.name: Medicaid Managed Care Plans
products.description: Comprehensive managed healthcare plans for Medicaid-eligible populations, including TANF, Medicaid Expansion, ABD, CHIP, LTSS, Foster Care, and dual-eligible members, delivered through state contracts and local provider networks.

products.name: Medicare Advantage Plans
products.description: Medicare Advantage (Part C) health insurance plans for seniors and eligible individuals, including Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans (D-SNPs), delivered via contracts with CMS and local provider networks, primarily under the Wellcare brand.

products.name: Medicare Prescription Drug Plans (PDPs)
products.description: Stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plans providing national in-network pharmacy coverage to Medicare-eligible beneficiaries, delivered through CMS contracts and pharmacy networks.

products.name: Commercial Health Insurance Plans (Marketplace and Group)
products.description: Health insurance products for individuals and employer groups, including ACA Health Insurance Marketplace plans and off-exchange individual and group plans, delivered through network contracts with providers under the Ambetter Health brand.

products.name: Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement (ICHRA) Plans
products.description: Off-exchange individual health insurance plans compatible with ICHRA, enabling employers to reimburse employees for individual premiums and medical expenses, delivered via Ambetter Health Solutions in select states.

products.name: Specialty Pharmacy Services
products.description: Specialty pharmacy services for patients with complex and chronic conditions, including medication dispensing, clinical support, and wholesale distribution, delivered through AcariaHealth.

products.name: Vision and Dental Benefit Programs
products.description: Fully integrated vision and dental health benefit programs, including routine and surgical eye care and dental services, delivered through contracted provider networks.

products.name: Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Behavioral health management and support services, including technology-enabled and in-person care, delivered to health plans, employers, government agencies, and other organizations, primarily through Magellan Health (divestiture pending).

products.name: Clinical Healthcare Services (Primary and Outpatient Care)
products.description: Direct clinical healthcare services, including primary care, certain specialty services, and social support, delivered through Community Medical Group and Denova Collaborative Health in select markets.

products.name: Elraglusib Injection
products.description: An intravenously administered, ATP-competitive small molecule GSK-3β inhibitor developed for the treatment of various cancers, including metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC), pediatric cancers (such as Ewing sarcoma and neuroblastoma), and other solid and hematologic tumors. The product is manufactured by third-party suppliers and delivered as an injectable drug for use in combination with standard chemotherapies or as a single agent in clinical settings.

products.name: Elraglusib Oral Tablet
products.description: An orally administered tablet formulation of elraglusib, a GSK-3β inhibitor, developed to expand the range of cancer indications and provide a more convenient dosing option for patients. The oral tablet is intended for use in adult patients with advanced, refractory cancers and is being advanced through clinical development for multiple solid tumor indications.

products.name: New Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of new vehicles from 54 brands through a network of physical dealerships and online platforms, requiring franchise agreements, inventory management, and compliance with manufacturer and regulatory standards.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of used and certified pre-owned vehicles via physical stores and e-commerce platforms, leveraging inventory management and logistics for in-store pickup or home delivery.

products.name: Automotive Financing Solutions
products.description: Provision of captive auto financing solutions for vehicle purchases, including loan origination and related financial products, delivered through both in-store and digital channels and subject to financial regulations.

products.name: Insurance and Protection Products
products.description: Offering of insurance and vehicle protection products (such as extended warranties and service contracts) to customers at the point of sale, integrated into the vehicle purchase process both online and in-store.

products.name: Aftersales Automotive Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of automotive repair, maintenance, and parts services through service departments at dealership locations, requiring skilled labor, specialized equipment, and compliance with environmental and safety regulations.

products.name: Fleet Management Services
products.description: Fleet management offerings for commercial customers, including vehicle acquisition, maintenance, and related services, leveraging the company’s physical network and digital capabilities.

products.name: E-Commerce Vehicle Retailing Platforms
products.description: Digital platforms (Driveway.com and GreenCars.com) enabling customers to buy, sell, or service vehicles online, including home delivery and digital customer support, supported by proprietary technology and logistics.

products.name: Sustainable Vehicle Sales and Education
products.description: Sales of electric and alternative-fuel vehicles, supported by GreenCars.com, which also provides consumer education and resources on sustainable mobility, incentives, and charging infrastructure.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Avidia Bank originates and services a broad range of loans, including residential mortgage loans, home equity and second mortgage loans, commercial real estate loans, multifamily loans, construction and land loans, commercial and industrial loans (including condominium association, dental practice, solar plant, and other business loans), and consumer loans. These are produced through in-person and digital channels, require significant underwriting, regulatory compliance, and are funded by deposits and capital.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Avidia Bank offers a variety of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and IRAs, as well as specialized Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) nationwide. These services are delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, and require regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Payments Processing Services
products.description: Avidia Bank provides payments processing services nationwide as a sponsor bank, including card acquiring/merchant processing, card issuing (debit, credit, prepaid cards for health and incentive programs), Automated Clearing House (ACH) solutions, and bill payment network sponsorship. These services are delivered through partnerships with ISOs, fintechs, and third-party processors, leveraging digital infrastructure and regulatory expertise.

products.name: AOC RNA Therapeutics for Rare Neuromuscular Diseases
products.description: Therapeutics based on proprietary Antibody Oligonucleotide Conjugate (AOC) technology, combining monoclonal antibodies with RNA therapeutics to target the root cause of rare neuromuscular diseases such as myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1), facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), and Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD). These are manufactured using scalable methods for mAbs and oligonucleotides and delivered via intravenous infusion.

products.name: AOC RNA Therapeutics for Precision Cardiology
products.description: Therapeutics developed using the AOC platform to target rare genetic cardiomyopathies, such as phospholamban (PLN) cardiomyopathy and PRKAG2 syndrome. These are in early-stage development and utilize the same antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate approach for targeted delivery to cardiac tissue.

products.name: AOC RNA Therapeutics for Immunology and Other Indications (Partnered Programs)
products.description: AOC-based therapeutics for immunology and other select indications, developed in collaboration with Eli Lilly and Company, targeting up to six selected mRNA targets outside of muscle. These are in preclinical or discovery stages and leverage the AOC platform for targeted delivery.

products.name: Guardant360 Tests (CDx, Liquid, Tissue)
products.description: A suite of comprehensive genomic profiling tests for solid tumors, including FDA-approved liquid biopsy (CDx), high-content liquid biopsy (Liquid), and tissue-based molecular profiling (Tissue). These tests are manufactured and processed in CLIA-certified labs and delivered as clinical reports to oncologists and researchers.

products.name: Guardant Reveal Test
products.description: A blood-based test for minimal residual disease (MRD) detection and recurrence monitoring in early-stage cancers, leveraging proprietary epigenomic technology and processed in certified labs. Delivered as clinical reports to oncologists for patient management and to biopharma for research.

products.name: Shield Test Platform
products.description: A blood-based cancer screening platform, currently FDA-approved for colorectal cancer screening and in development for lung and multi-cancer detection. Utilizes multimodal molecular analysis and is processed in clinical labs, with results provided to clinicians and patients.

products.name: GuardantINFINITY Test
products.description: A modular, high-content blood-based assay for biopharmaceutical research, providing multi-dimensional genomic and epigenomic tumor profiling and immune response insights. Delivered as research reports to biopharma clients for drug development and clinical research.

products.name: GuardantOMNI Test
products.description: A blood-based genomic profiling test covering 500 genes, designed for biopharmaceutical translational research and retrospective clinical study sample analysis. Processed in labs and results delivered to biopharma clients.

products.name: GuardantINFORM Platform
products.description: A real-world data and analytics platform aggregating genomic and clinical data from Guardant tests, providing AI-enabled insights for biopharmaceutical companies to accelerate drug development and research. Delivered as data and analytical reports.

products.name: GuardantConnect
products.description: A software-based clinical trial matching service that connects patients tested with Guardant assays to relevant clinical studies, serving both clinical and biopharmaceutical customers. Delivered as a digital platform and service.

products.name: Gold Bullion
products.description: Gold bullion is produced through mining operations at several sites, processed into doré or concentrate, refined by third-party refiners, and sold to banks, trading houses, and refiners globally. Production requires physical mining, ore processing, and compliance with regulatory standards.

products.name: Silver Bullion
products.description: Silver bullion is produced from mining operations, processed into doré, refined by third-party refiners, and sold to global customers. Production involves underground and open pit mining, ore processing, and adherence to industry standards.

products.name: Gold Concentrate
products.description: Gold concentrate is produced primarily at the Kensington mine, shipped under long-term offtake agreements to third-party smelters. Production involves underground mining, ore concentration, and logistics for international shipment.

products.name: Silver-Gold Concentrate
products.description: Silver-gold concentrate is produced at certain mining complexes and sold to third-party smelters. Production requires mining, ore processing, and concentration before shipment to customers.

products.name: Zinc and Lead Concentrates (Exploration Stage)
products.description: Zinc and lead concentrates are potential products from the Silvertip exploration project, involving underground mining and ore processing, though currently at the exploration stage and not yet a primary revenue driver.

products.name: Copper-Gold Concentrate (Pending Acquisition)
products.description: Copper-gold concentrate will be produced at the New Afton mine in Canada, pending completion of the New Gold acquisition. Production involves mining and processing copper and gold ores into concentrate for sale to smelters.

products.name: Educational Furniture
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes a comprehensive range of movable furniture for educational environments, including seating, desks, tables, storage, and specialized classroom solutions. Products are produced in large-scale domestic manufacturing facilities and delivered directly to schools and educational institutions.

products.name: Administrative and Office Furniture
products.description: Manufactures and supplies desks, returns, bookcases, filing cabinets, and other office furniture for administrative offices in educational and commercial settings, using metal forming and woodworking capabilities.

products.name: Laboratory and Science Furniture
products.description: Produces wood and steel-based science tables and laboratory furniture for biology, chemistry, and other lab settings in schools and colleges, including specialty tops and adjustable lab stools.

products.name: Technology and Media Furniture
products.description: Designs and manufactures technology tables, media stations, and workstations with integrated power, USB ports, and TV mounts for collaborative and digital learning or business environments.

products.name: Mobile and Folding Furniture
products.description: Offers a range of mobile tables, mobile storage units, mobile chairs, folding chairs, and folding tables for flexible use in cafeterias, classrooms, event venues, and other multi-use spaces. Products are manufactured using steel, plastic, and wood components.

products.name: Outdoor Furniture
products.description: Manufactures and supplies outdoor benches and tables, including ADA-compliant models, for schools, parks, playgrounds, campgrounds, and public spaces. Products are available in multiple colors and designed for durability in outdoor environments.

products.name: Furniture Delivery and Installation Services
products.description: Provides full-service delivery, inside delivery, and turnkey classroom setup for furniture purchases, including project management, CAD layouts, and installation planning. Services are delivered by in-house teams and are often bundled with product sales.

products.name: Furniture for Non-Educational Markets
products.description: Supplies furniture and equipment for convention centers, arenas, hospitality venues, government facilities, and places of worship, leveraging the same manufacturing and distribution capabilities as for educational markets.

products.name: Resale of Third-Party Furniture and Equipment
products.description: Purchases and resells furniture and equipment from other manufacturers, including wood and steel office furniture, early learning products, science laboratory furniture, and library tables and equipment, to provide a comprehensive offering to customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas produced primarily from the Haynesville and Bossier shale plays in North Louisiana and East Texas, utilizing advanced horizontal drilling and completion technologies. The product is delivered via pipelines to customers in the Gulf Coast and other markets.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of crude oil and natural gas liquids (NGLs) as byproducts from shale wells, delivered to market via pipelines and sold at market prices. Production is a smaller portion of total output compared to natural gas.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Treating Services
products.description: Provision of gathering and treating services for natural gas, primarily through the Pinnacle Gas Services LLC system, which includes gas treating plants and high-pressure pipelines. These services support both internal production and may be available to third parties in the Western Haynesville area.

products.name: Residential Whole Loan Investments
products.description: Acquisition and holding of residential whole loans, including Non-QM loans, business purpose loans (such as transitional, fix and flip, and single-family rental loans), and legacy re-performing/non-performing loans. These are originated or acquired, often through consolidated trusts, and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Business Purpose Loan Origination and Servicing
products.description: Origination and servicing of business purpose loans for real estate investors, including single-family and multifamily transitional loans and single-family rental loans, primarily through the Lima One subsidiary. This involves underwriting, funding, and managing loans secured by residential and multifamily properties, requiring in-person labor, financial capital, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Securities Investments
products.description: Investment in residential mortgage-backed securities, including Agency MBS, Non-Agency MBS, and credit risk transfer (CRT) securities. These are purchased and held as financial assets, requiring capital allocation and expertise in fixed income markets.

products.name: Real Estate Owned (REO) Sales
products.description: Ownership and sale of real estate properties acquired through foreclosure or liquidation of delinquent loans. These properties are managed and disposed of as part of loan resolution activities, involving asset management and real estate sales processes.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Provision of investment management and advisory services to external investment vehicles, including private funds, business development companies, and REITs. Services are delivered through registered investment adviser subsidiaries and involve management, property management, incentive, and administration fees based on assets under management, rent collected, and investment performance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing and Development
products.description: Acquisition, development, and leasing of commercial land parcels and build-to-suit improvements, primarily through long-term commercial lease agreements. The company constructs improvements on acquired land and leases them to tenants, with the intention to sell the land and improvements with attached leases.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a variety of commercial and industrial loans, including working capital lines of credit, equipment loans and leases, loans to technology companies, inventory and accounts receivable lines, and loans to tax-exempt municipalities and not-for-profit organizations. These are originated and serviced through in-person banking relationships and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans to fund the purchase, refinancing, or development of commercial real estate properties, including both owner-occupied and non-owner occupied properties such as multi-family, office, industrial, retail, and hotel properties. These loans are secured by real estate and require in-depth underwriting and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provides loans for construction and land development projects, including single family and multi-family residential projects, industrial/warehouse properties, office buildings, retail centers, and residential lot developments. These loans are originated to experienced developers and require project-specific underwriting and monitoring.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers residential real estate loans, including both conforming and non-conforming mortgages, through direct origination and bulk loan purchases. These are delivered via in-person and digital channels and require compliance with mortgage regulations.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides limited consumer loan products such as home equity loans and lines of credit, home improvement loans, personal lines of credit, and loans to individuals for investment purposes. These are typically smaller in scale and delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a range of deposit accounts including demand deposits, checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit, delivered through branch and online channels. These products are core to the bank's funding and require regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides treasury and cash management services such as funds transfer, lock box, wire transfers, electronic bill payment, and courier services to business customers. These services are delivered via digital platforms and require secure, regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Payment Services
products.description: Offers digital payment solutions, including specialized services for the class action legal industry, delivered through proprietary digital platforms. These services require secure technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Provides mortgage banking services, including origination, purchase, and sale of residential mortgage loans, primarily through its AmeriHome subsidiary. These services are delivered via digital and in-person channels and require significant regulatory compliance.

products.name: Corporate Trust and Loan Administration Services
products.description: Offers corporate trust services and levered loan administration solutions through its WATC subsidiary, serving institutional clients. These services are delivered through specialized teams and require regulatory oversight and expertise in financial administration.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Extraction and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from onshore reserves in the Eagle Ford, Permian, and Uinta Basins, using physical drilling, hydraulic fracturing, and well operations. Products are delivered via pipelines or truck to customers and sold at negotiated market prices.

products.name: Mineral and Royalty Interests
products.description: Ownership and leasing of mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas producing basins, entitling Crescent to a cost-free percentage of production revenue from third-party operated wells, with no capital or operating costs required.

products.name: Midstream Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provision of oil and gas gathering and transportation services through ownership interests in midstream assets, such as the Springfield Gathering System, which serve both Crescent's upstream assets and third-party customers. These services require regulated infrastructure and physical assets.

products.name: Ethanol
products.description: Ethanol is produced at company-owned and affiliated dry-mill facilities by fermenting corn and is sold as a renewable fuel additive and octane enhancer for gasoline. Production requires physical manufacturing, commodity procurement, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Distillers Grains (DDGS and Wet Distillers Grains)
products.description: Distillers grains, both dried (DDGS) and wet, are protein-rich by-products of ethanol production, sold primarily as animal feed. Production is integrated with ethanol manufacturing and involves physical processing and logistics.

products.name: Distillers Corn Oil
products.description: Distillers corn oil is extracted during the ethanol production process and sold to animal feed, biodiesel, and chemical markets. Production is a by-product of dry-mill ethanol manufacturing and requires physical extraction and distribution.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provision of short and medium-term commercial loans, commercial credit lines, construction and real estate loans to businesses and professional individuals, primarily through in-person relationship banking and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans, including personal loans and home equity products, delivered through branch locations and digital channels, requiring regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering business and personal deposit accounts, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and retirement accounts, managed through physical branches and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provision of treasury and cash management solutions such as corporate purchasing cards, integrated payables, merchant services, sweep accounts, and remote deposit capture, delivered via digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Electronic and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Digital banking services for consumers and businesses, including online banking, mobile apps, mobile deposit, bill pay, peer-to-peer payments, and account management, delivered via proprietary digital platforms.

products.name: Home Mortgage Lending and Servicing
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of 1-4 family residential mortgages, including FHA, VA, conventional, and specialized Alaska Housing Finance Corporation products, with most loans sold to the secondary market and some retained for investment.

products.name: Factoring and Asset Based Lending
products.description: Provision of working capital solutions to businesses by purchasing accounts receivable (factoring), asset based lending, and alternative working capital products, delivered through specialized subsidiaries and affiliates in the US, Canada, and UK.

products.name: Investment and Annuity Products
products.description: Offering of annuity products and long-term investment portfolios to customers, typically through third-party vendors and investment advisory partnerships, delivered via in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Application Services
products.description: A suite of cloud-based products that provide security, performance, and reliability for Internet properties such as websites, APIs, and applications. Delivered via Cloudflare's global network, these services include web application firewall, DDoS mitigation, bot management, API security, SSL/TLS encryption, content delivery, load balancing, DNS, and analytics.

products.name: SASE Platform (Zero Trust and Network Services)
products.description: A cloud-based Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform combining Zero Trust security and network services to secure, connect, and accelerate corporate networks, users, and devices. Delivered as a unified service, it replaces legacy network hardware and includes WAN connectivity, firewalls, secure web gateways, remote browser isolation, and email security.

products.name: Developer Platform (Serverless, Compute, Storage, and AI)
products.description: A global, serverless developer platform enabling customers to build, deploy, and scale applications—including AI, compute, storage, and media—without managing infrastructure. Delivered via Cloudflare's distributed network, it includes Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, object storage, databases, and media streaming APIs.

products.name: Consumer Internet Security and Privacy Products
products.description: A set of consumer-focused products providing secure, private, and performant Internet experiences, including DNS resolver apps (1.1.1.1), VPN (WARP), and secure domain registration. Delivered as cloud-based services and mobile apps, these products are designed for individual users and families.

products.name: Esports Tournaments and Live Gaming Events
products.description: Production and hosting of large-scale esports tournaments, gaming competitions, and live entertainment events at physical venues such as HyperX Arena Las Vegas and mobile arenas, as well as at partner locations globally. These events require in-person human labor, regulated infrastructure, and event management expertise.

products.name: Mobile Gaming (Casual, Card, and Mahjong Games)
products.description: Development, operation, and monetization of casual mobile games, including premium card and Mahjong games, primarily through the Allied Mobile Entertainment subsidiary and the Z-Tech partnership. Delivered digitally via app stores, with revenue from in-app purchases, ads, and subscriptions.

products.name: Original and Multiplatform Entertainment Content
products.description: Creation and production of proprietary entertainment content, including original IP, tournament broadcasts, game shows, and cultural programming, distributed across digital streaming, social media, theatrical releases, and live broadcasts. Monetized via licensing, sponsorship, and direct-to-consumer models.

products.name: Location-Based Entertainment Venues and Experiences
products.description: Operation and development of experiential entertainment hubs and venues that blend gaming, music, nightlife, and immersive media, including flagship arenas and planned expansions in Las Vegas, Hainan, and Japan. These require physical infrastructure, event production, and hospitality services.

products.name: Interactive Digital Services and Community Engagement Platforms
products.description: Provision of interactive digital services such as online tournaments, leaderboards, community platforms (e.g., Discord, YouTube, Twitch), and engagement tools that connect fans and players, drive retention, and support monetization through ads, sponsorships, and digital goods.

products.name: Forged and Machined Components for Commercial Vehicles
products.description: Manufacture and supply of forged, machined, welded, and heat-treated steel components such as axle shafts, transmission shafts, gear sets, and steer axle knuckles for commercial vehicle, off-highway, recreational vehicle, and automotive OEMs. Production involves heavy industrial manufacturing processes and is often delivered under multi-year, sole-source contracts.

products.name: Pipeline Closures and Specialty Energy Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of high-pressure closures, insulated joints, and other specialty fabricated products for oil and gas, water pipelines, and industrial applications. These products are produced using advanced fabrication and engineering processes for critical infrastructure sectors.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Electronics Manufacturing Services
products.description: Provision of contract manufacturing services including circuit card assembly, full box build manufacturing, high reliability manufacturing, systems assembly and integration, and design for manufacturability for aerospace, defense, and space markets. Services are delivered through regulated, high-complexity manufacturing processes for mission-critical electronic systems.

products.name: Allogeneic Gamma-Delta T Cell Therapy (INB-100)
products.description: An allogeneic, ex vivo expanded and activated gamma-delta T cell therapy derived from healthy donors, administered to patients with hematologic malignancies undergoing allogeneic stem cell transplantation. Manufactured using proprietary cell-type specific expansion and cryopreservation processes, delivered as a cellular infusion post-transplant.

products.name: Genetically Modified Autologous Gamma-Delta T Cell Therapy (INB-200/INB-400)
products.description: An autologous, genetically engineered gamma-delta T cell therapy designed to be resistant to alkylating chemotherapies, primarily for newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM). Manufactured from patient blood, modified to express MGMT for chemotherapy resistance, expanded ex vivo, and delivered via intracranial catheter in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy.

products.name: Gamma-Delta T Cell Engagers (TCEs) Platform (INB-600/INB-619)
products.description: A biologic platform of gamma-delta T cell engagers (TCEs) designed to selectively activate and expand gamma-delta T cells in vivo for targeted cytotoxicity against cancer and autoimmune diseases. Includes CD19-targeted TCEs for B cell malignancies and autoimmune indications, manufactured as recombinant proteins for systemic administration.

products.name: Non-Signaling Chimeric Antigen Receptor Gamma-Delta T Cell Therapy (INB-300)
products.description: A preclinical gamma-delta T cell therapy using non-signaling CAR constructs to target both solid and liquid tumors. Manufactured by genetically modifying gamma-delta T cells to express tumor-targeting CARs without activating signals, aiming to distinguish tumor from healthy tissue.

products.name: iPSC-Derived Gamma-Delta T Cell Therapy (INB-500)
products.description: A preclinical platform for generating gamma-delta T cells from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), enabling scalable, allogeneic, potentially off-the-shelf innate cellular therapies for cancer. Involves proprietary methods for iPSC differentiation and genetic modification, with potential for large-scale manufacturing.

products.name: High-Power Lithium Battery Cells
products.description: Manufactured cylindrical lithium-ion battery cells (models 26650, 26700, 32140, 40135) using lithium iron phosphate (LFP) or NCM materials, produced in large-scale automated facilities and supplied to light electric vehicles, electric vehicles, and energy storage applications.

products.name: High-Power Sodium Battery Cells
products.description: Manufactured cylindrical sodium-ion battery cells (notably model 32140), produced in automated plants, designed for use in electric vehicles and energy storage, with advantages in low-temperature and fast-charging environments.

products.name: Battery Packs and Integrated Battery Systems
products.description: Assembly of individual battery cells into complete, plug-and-play battery packs and systems, manufactured in dedicated facilities, primarily for direct use in light electric vehicle battery swapping infrastructure and energy storage applications.

products.name: NCM Cathode Materials
products.description: Manufacture and sale of nickel-cobalt-manganese (NCM) cathode materials, a critical component for high-power lithium-ion batteries, produced in specialized chemical plants and supplied to battery manufacturers.

products.name: NCM Precursor Materials
products.description: Production and sale of NCM precursor materials (nickel, cobalt, manganese salts), used as feedstock for cathode material manufacturing, produced in chemical processing facilities and sold to cathode and battery manufacturers.
